sources.title: Kriminalitätsatlas Berlin — Fallzahlen und Häufigkeitszahlen 2016–2025
sources.used_for: ‘Kieztaten’ (neighbourhood offences) per 100,000 residents, averaged over 2023–2025, per Bezirksregion.
sources.caveat: Reported offences per 100,000 registered residents. ‘Kieztaten’ are the police's neighbourhood-related offences (e.g. assault, threats, robbery, burglary, vandalism of cars). Areas many people visit (centre, nightlife, transport hubs) read higher than what residents experience; the police note a high rate can also reflect liveliness and popularity. Averaged over three years.

sources.title: Einwohnerregisterstatistik Berlin, 31. Dezember 2024 (Statistischer Bericht A I 16 – hj 2/24), Tabelle 2
sources.used_for: Residents by age group per LOR-Planungsraum, summed to Bezirksregionen.
sources.caveat: Registered main residences on 31 Dec 2024. We use age groups only; nationality and migration-background figures are deliberately not used.

sources.title: Berliner Betriebskostenübersicht 2026 (Abrechnungsjahr 2024)
sources.publisher: Senatsverwaltung für Stadtentwicklung, Bauen und Wohnen
sources.used_for: Average operating costs (cold + heating/hot water) to turn cold rent into warm rent.
sources.caveat: Averages from larger housing companies' statements; individual flats vary.

sources.title: IBB Wohnungsmarktbericht 2025 — Zusammenfassung
sources.used_for: Median asking rents (net cold) for Berlin, inner city and outer city.
sources.caveat: Asking rents from listings (VALUE Marktdatenbank), not signed contracts; Berlin-wide, not per neighbourhood.

sources.title: Lebensweltlich orientierte Räume (LOR) 2021 — Planungsräume (WGS84)
sources.publisher: Senatsverwaltung für Stadtentwicklung, Bauen und Wohnen / Amt für Statistik Berlin-Brandenburg
sources.used_for: Planning-area boundaries (area, centre points) and the official ‘Innere Stadt’ / ‘Äußere Stadt’ classification.
sources.caveat: Region centre points are population-weighted, i.e. where people live, not the geometric middle of parks or rail yards.

sources.title: Umweltgerechtigkeitsatlas 2023/2024 (Broschüre), ‘Aufschlüsselung der Planungsräume nach Belastungssituation’
sources.publisher: Senatsverwaltung für Mobilität, Verkehr, Klimaschutz und Umwelt
sources.used_for: Noise, air, heat and green-space burden class (low / medium / high) per Planungsraum, weighted by residents to Bezirksregionen.
sources.caveat: Classes are relative to the rest of Berlin (lowest quarter = low, highest quarter = high), not absolute health thresholds. The atlas's social-disadvantage indicator is deliberately not used.

sources.title: Pressemitteilung: Neue Zahlen zu Studentischen Wohnkosten Sommersemester 2025 (10.03.2025)
sources.used_for: Typical Berlin WG-room price and student housing allowances.
sources.caveat: Average ‘ordinary’ WG room from listings; whole flats cost more.

sources.title: IBB Wohnungsmarktbericht 2025 — Tabellenband, Tab. 25 ‘Angebotsmieten nach Bezirken 2025’
sources.publisher: Investitionsbank Berlin (IBB); data: VALUE Marktdatenbank, RegioKontext GmbH
sources.used_for: Median asking rent (net cold) per district, and the range that 80% of offers fall into.
sources.caveat: District medians from listings, not signed contracts. Neighbourhoods within a district differ; the range shows how much.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap — Geofabrik ‘berlin-latest-free’ GeoPackage
sources.publisher: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL 1.0), extract by Geofabrik GmbH
sources.used_for: Cafés, shops, doctors, bars, culture and sport venues; residential land; lakes, rivers and forests.
sources.caveat: Community-mapped: very complete in Berlin but not official. Distances are straight lines from homes, so real walks are a little longer.

sources.title: VBB GTFS timetable — weekday peak network (07:00–09:00)
sources.used_for: S-Bahn, U-Bahn, regional-rail and tram stops with peak-hour service.
sources.caveat: Buses are not counted: almost everyone in Berlin lives near one.
